idea-plugin.name: Surface Dial Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Companion plugin for the Surface Dial Evolved GNOME Shell extension. Exposes a small, token-protected HTTP API on IntelliJ's built-in server (http://127.0.0.1:63342/api/dial/...) so the Surface Dial can run IDE actions by ID.
  • GET /api/dial/ping
  • GET /api/dial/action?id=<ActionId>
Requests must carry the X-Dial-Token header matching ~/.config/surface-dial-evolved/intellij-token; browser requests (with an Origin header) are rejected.
